record.name: Otter AI
record.one_liner: Otter AI offers meeting transcription, AI summaries, an MCP server, and an Enterprise-tier API & Webhooks for integrations.

auth.notes: The pages mention an 'Otter API & Webhooks' offering on the Enterprise plan, but do not document the specific authentication mechanism used.

access.notes: The Otter API & Webhooks are listed under the Enterprise plan, requiring users to 'Schedule a demo' or contact sales.

api_surface.notes: Webhooks and an API are mentioned as part of the Enterprise tier, but no technical details or SDKs are described.

mcp.notes: The pages state that Otter provides an Otter MCP Server allowing AI chat tools like ChatGPT and Claude to access meeting knowledge.

buildability.reasoning: Access to the API requires an Enterprise contract and contacting sales, and the pages provide no documentation for the API or its authentication.

evidence.claim: ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI chat tools can securely access your meeting knowledge through Otter’s MCP Server.
Otter API & Webhooks are available under the Enterprise tier for large teams and companies.
Otter MCP server is included in the Basic plan.
